description:
Wayfront is agency client portal software for digital agencies selling repeatable productized services. Each purchase starts the right workflow, while repeat orders, renewals, referrals, prepaid packages, and reseller sales create more value from the client relationship.

Connect Wayfront to ChatGPT and work with your agency’s current client and delivery data. Analyze conversations, catch follow-ups, find the right next service to offer, and update CRM records while the context is still fresh.

You can also create and adjust services and forms through chat. Tighten intake, fix clunky handoffs, and keep work moving from purchase to delivery.

defaultPrompt: Review recent client messages on active orders. Flag unanswered questions, delivery risks, and the next action for each.
Audit my latest public order form. Flag confusing fields, checkout issues, and delivery risks, then suggest exact fixes.
Review my sales pipeline. Identify stalled or promising opportunities and recommend the next action for each.
